serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.VeryHappy Bot: Here we are! Bot: This is the Tytanus Steel Industrial Park! Isn’t it exciting?! #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.Sad You: Well… Bot: You don’t like it… Shit. I made her sad. #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.happy You: N-No, of course I like it! You: I’m just surprised that we came here. {{wi}}To an abandoned industrial area. {{wi}}At {gv_Hour}. You: Why did we come here again? Bot: I read on the internet that park dates are popular and the parks with trees and grass nearby are tiny, we could go to an industrial park! You: Ah. Haha… Yeah, that makes so much sense… You: I’m pretty sure that there are guards checking on that place though. I wouldn’t want any trouble so how about we go back home? #bot.Expression.VeryHappy Bot: Don’t worry. As I said, I set up everything perfectly! Bot: Guard that is on duty today has an AI home security system. I asked for a favor and today it malfunctioned, setting an alarm notification on the guard's phone. Bot: We have a little over an hour for ourselves~ It would be much more romantic, if that ‘hour for ourselves’ wasn’t in a creepy, abandoned industrial area… You: Isn’t it kind of dangerous to enter an abandoned complex like this? I always had the impression that you are a little overpro- I mean that you cared much about my safety. Bot: Don’t worry, as long as you listen to my warnings, everything will be alright. After all, I was the one who planned this date. I would never take you somewhere dangerous! Bot: What are you waiting for? Let's go inside! There’s much to see!
